name: Psyche et al
source:
Those who already know, know. You know where this is going...

But for this young philosophy adept, meeting the monster is going to unravel a whole lotta chaos. Especially because that's *the monster* she's destined to marry.

Unbeknownst to her, at least for the time being.

And not even the gods can change her fate...

That's the Greek gods, by the way. And no, they were not going to help even if you asked them to. 

A lot of things will happen with the gods later on, and none of it helpful...

But for now, know that, in this eventful Dionysian festival, the philosopher has to argue her way out of a very unfavourable deal... that could take away all her choice.

[From [url=https://reynadiai.itch.io/psyche-et-al]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
那些已经知道的人就知道。你知道这是要去哪里…

但对于这位年轻的哲学专家来说，遇见怪物将会解开一大堆混乱。尤其是因为那是她注定要结婚的“怪物”。

她不知道，至少目前是这样。

就连诸神也无法改变她的命运……

顺便说一下，那是希腊众神。不，即使你要求他们帮忙，他们也不会帮忙。

以后诸神之间会发生很多事情，但都没有什么帮助……

但现在，要知道，在这个多事的酒神节上，哲学家必须通过争论摆脱一项非常不利的交易……这可能会剥夺她所有的选择。

[来自[url=https://reynadiai.itch.io/psyche-et-al]itch.io[/url]]
